segments.title: Apple Music is getting a KARAOKE camera
segments.say: Apple Music is about to turn your iPhone into a karaoke camera. It's in the iOS 27.3 beta.

segments.title: It's called Selfie Sing
segments.say: It's called Selfie Sing. You film yourself singing along.

segments.title: How it works
segments.say: Play a song, open the lyrics, and tap the new camera button on the right.

segments.title: Beta only, for now
segments.say: It's beta only for now, expected for everyone in December.

segments.title: Source: 9to5Mac
segments.say: That's from nine to five Mac. Not tested by us.
Follow for Phone Trick number 20 tomorrow.
